lines.zh: 我沿着溪边的阴影游，不进亮处。
lines.en: I follow the stream's shade and avoid the light.

lines.zh: 苔藓垂到水里，我从下面钻过。
lines.en: Moss hangs into the water; I slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍抵住水流，一寸寸挪。
lines.en: I brace my tail against the current and inch along.

lines.zh: 溪水只有两格宽，我刚好转身。
lines.en: The stream is two blocks wide; I barely turn.

lines.zh: 岩缝是我的路，我认得每一道。
lines.en: Rock seams are my roads; I know each one.

lines.zh: 我贴着阴影走，斑点隐在里面。
lines.en: I keep to shade, my spots vanishing into it.

lines.zh: 同伴游在前面，我落后半步。
lines.en: My school swims ahead; I trail half a step.

lines.zh: 落叶在水面转，我绕开它。
lines.en: A leaf spins on the surface; I go around.

lines.zh: 我向上游，水声越来越细。
lines.en: I head upstream as the water's voice thins.

lines.zh: 溪底是碎石，我走得很轻。
lines.en: The bed is loose gravel; I move lightly.

lines.zh: 我从苔池的一头游到另一头。
lines.en: I cross the mossy pool from end to end.

lines.zh: 每隔一会儿，我就换个藏身处。
lines.en: Every little while I change hiding places.

lines.zh: 冬天的水更清，也更快。
lines.en: Winter water runs clearer and faster.

lines.zh: 我顺着倒木的影子游过去。
lines.en: I swim along the shadow of a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 我侧身一闪，让过漂下来的枝条。
lines.en: I roll onto my side to let a drifting branch pass.

lines.zh: 水浅处我摆得急，鳍几乎露出水面。
lines.en: In the shallows I flick hard, fins almost breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 同伴拐弯，我也拐，没有掉队。
lines.en: My school turns and I turn, staying in line.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头底下一路摸到下一块。
lines.en: I work my way from one stone's shelter to the next.

lines.zh: 我停在苔藓下，只露出尾尖。
lines.en: I rest under moss with only my tail showing.

lines.zh: 冷水过鳃，我几乎不动。
lines.en: Cold water passes my gills; I barely move.

lines.zh: 溪水声盖住了我所有的动静。
lines.en: The stream's noise covers every sound I make.

lines.zh: 我在石影里等一只落水的虫子。
lines.en: In a stone's shadow I wait for a fallen insect.

lines.zh: 同伴躲在另一块石下，我们互不打扰。
lines.en: My schoolmates hide under another stone; we keep apart.

lines.zh: 苔藓的绿映在我背上，很难看清。
lines.en: Moss green falls on my back, making me hard to see.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，咬住一缕水草。
lines.en: I turn broadside and mouth a strand of weed.

lines.zh: 水面浮着一层薄雾。
lines.en: A thin mist floats on the water.

lines.zh: 我很少露面，露面就意味着饿。
lines.en: I seldom show myself; showing means hunger.

lines.zh: 溪鳟比别的鳟鱼都小一圈。
lines.en: I am a size smaller than the other trout.

lines.zh: 我听着岸上脚步，没有抬头。
lines.en: I hear steps on the bank and do not look up.

lines.zh: 阴影挪了半格，我也挪半格。
lines.en: The shadow shifts half a block; so do I.

lines.zh: 水冷得让我格外清醒。
lines.en: The cold water keeps me sharply awake.

lines.zh: 我在等一个足够安全的时刻。
lines.en: I am waiting for a moment safe enough.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探出半个头看你。
lines.en: I poke half my head from a rock seam to watch.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我把身体压低。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I press myself low.

lines.zh: 我看见鱼竿，却没看见钩。
lines.en: I see the rod but not the hook.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，一动不动。
lines.en: I fix on your boots and do not move.

lines.zh: 你的影子投进水里，我退到暗处。
lines.en: Your shadow falls in the water; I retreat into dark.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，你才看见我。
lines.en: I watch you long before you see me.

lines.zh: 我把斑点对着你，当作伪装。
lines.en: I face you with my speckles, trusting my disguise.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，我钻进了苔下。
lines.en: When you bend down, I vanish under the moss.

lines.zh: 苔藓盖着的池塘，才藏得住我。
lines.en: Only a mossy pool can hide me.

lines.zh: 你看不清我，这正合我意。
lines.en: You cannot make me out, which suits me.

lines.zh: 剑尖碰到我，我猛地钻进苔里。
lines.en: The blade touches me and I bolt into the moss.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下一片鳞，漂走了。
lines.en: A scale comes loose and drifts away.

lines.zh: 疼得我撞在石头上。
lines.en: The pain slams me into a stone.

lines.zh: 我只挨三下就会不动。
lines.en: Three hits and I stop moving.

lines.zh: 血混进溪水，红得很快变淡。
lines.en: Blood mixes with the stream and fades fast.

lines.zh: 我往最暗的缝里逃。
lines.en: I flee into the darkest crevice.

lines.zh: 同伴一哄而散，我一个人。
lines.en: My school scatters, and I am alone.

lines.zh: 你打中我的侧腹，我翻了一下。
lines.en: You hit my flank and I roll once.

lines.zh: 我想躲，可溪就这么宽。
lines.en: I want to hide, but the stream is only this wide.

lines.zh: 力气从鳃边一点点漏掉。
lines.en: Strength leaks away past my gills.

lines.zh: 虫子落水的那一刻，我动摇了。
lines.en: The instant the insect lands, I waver.

lines.zh: 我先在苔边看，确认没有影子。
lines.en: I watch from the moss and check for shadows.

lines.zh: 饵很香，可岸上的你更让我在意。
lines.en: The bait smells good, but you on the bank worry me more.

lines.zh: 我等同伴先咬，它没动。
lines.en: I wait for a schoolmate to bite; it does not.

lines.zh: 我靠近半步，又退回石后。
lines.en: I come half a step closer, then slip back.

lines.zh: 这条溪里没有比虫更值得冒险的。
lines.en: Nothing in this stream is worth more risk than an insect.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，也听见了线动的声音。
lines.en: I smell it, and hear the line shift too.

lines.zh: 饥饿最终压过了谨慎。
lines.en: Hunger finally outweighs my caution.

lines.zh: 我只咬一小口，随时能放。
lines.en: I take one small bite, ready to let go.

lines.zh: 你换了新饵，我离得更近了。
lines.en: You change the bait, and I edge closer.

lines.zh: 你踩进溪里，水浑了一片。
lines.en: You step into the stream and mud clouds it.

lines.zh: 我被水流推着撞上你的靴子。
lines.en: The current pushes me against your boot.

lines.zh: 石块边太窄，我蹭掉了鳞。
lines.en: The gap by the stone is too narrow; I scrape off scales.

lines.zh: 我躲得急，尾鳍拍在桶壁上。
lines.en: Ducking fast, I slap my tail on the bucket.

lines.zh: 你一动，整条溪都在晃。
lines.en: You move, and the whole stream sways.

lines.zh: 我撞进苔藓，绿色的絮粘满身。
lines.en: I blunder into moss and green threads cling to me.

lines.zh: 两次擦撞，我就换了个藏身处。
lines.en: Two bumps and I find another hiding place.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才敢浮上来。
lines.en: Only when you step back do I rise.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿边滑走，水花很轻。
lines.en: I slip past your leg with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 这条溪容不下两个大家伙。
lines.en: This stream cannot hold two big creatures.

lines.zh: 水转凉时，我在砾石上刨窝。
lines.en: As the water cools, I dig a nest in gravel.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍扫开碎石，露出净底。
lines.en: I sweep the gravel clear with my tail.

lines.zh: 一条同伴贴过来，我们并排。
lines.en: A schoolmate presses close; we pair up.

lines.zh: 卵落进石缝，我用沙盖住。
lines.en: Eggs fall into the gravel; I cover them with sand.

lines.zh: 苔池最深处，我们才敢产卵。
lines.en: Only in the pool's deepest part do we spawn.

lines.zh: 我守着窝，把靠近的鱼赶开。
lines.en: I guard the nest and drive off any fish.

lines.zh: 冷水里，我们的动作都很慢。
lines.en: In cold water, all our movements slow.

lines.zh: 冬季的水清得能看见每一颗卵。
lines.en: Winter water is clear enough to count every egg.

lines.zh: 我把身体横在窝前挡水。
lines.en: I lay my body across the nest to block the flow.

lines.zh: 等卵稳了，我才离开。
lines.en: Only once the eggs settle do I leave.

lines.zh: 我把落水的蛾子顶到石缝里。
lines.en: I nudge a drowned moth into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 嘴里叼着虫，我不好转身。
lines.en: With an insect in my mouth, I cannot turn well.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片苔，尝了尝又吐。
lines.en: I pick up moss, taste it, and spit it out.

lines.zh: 水底的碎壳被我含了一路。
lines.en: I carry a shell fragment a long way.

lines.zh: 我只会用嘴，东西常掉。
lines.en: Mouth only, so things often drop.

lines.zh: 你扔下的饵，我叼走藏进苔下。
lines.en: I take the bait you drop and hide it under moss.

lines.zh: 我试着搬一块小石，没搬动。
lines.en: I try to move a pebble and fail.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西时，我游得最慢。
lines.en: With my mouth full I swim at my slowest.

lines.zh: 同伴来抢，我一口吞下。
lines.en: A schoolmate comes to steal; I swallow it.

lines.zh: 我在石下藏了三样东西。
lines.en: Under one stone I have hidden three things.

lines.zh: 一只石蝇落水，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: A stonefly falls, and my head lifts at once.

lines.zh: 水纹从上游传来，我知道有吃的。
lines.en: Ripples come from upstream; I know it is food.

lines.zh: 我离开苔影，向亮处游了一格。
lines.en: I leave the moss shade and swim one block into light.

lines.zh: 那道银光在钩上闪了一下。
lines.en: Something silver glints on the hook.

lines.zh: 我的目标很简单：那团动的东西。
lines.en: My target is simple: the thing that moves.

lines.zh: 我先从下游绕，避开你的影子。
lines.en: I loop from downstream, away from your shadow.

lines.zh: 饥饿让我的判断变得很快。
lines.en: Hunger makes my judgement quick.

lines.zh: 我锁定了水面下那块面包。
lines.en: I lock onto the bread below the surface.

lines.zh: 同伴还在苔下，我已经出来了。
lines.en: My school still hides in moss; I am already out.

lines.zh: 这次我会咬得比上次实。
lines.en: This time I will bite harder than last.

lines.zh: 我伏在石后，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I lie behind a stone with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 钩子晃了两下，我没动。
lines.en: The hook sways twice; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我在等它稳住的那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for the instant it steadies.

lines.zh: 水流把它推向我，正好。
lines.en: The current pushes it toward me, perfect.

lines.zh: 我把身体压平，贴着溪底。
lines.en: I flatten myself along the stream bed.

lines.zh: 同伴退开了，把这一口让给我。
lines.en: My schoolmate backs off and leaves me this bite.

lines.zh: 我看清了钩尖，也看清了线。
lines.en: I see the hook point, and the line too.

lines.zh: 再等一下，等它离石头更近。
lines.en: Wait a little longer, until it nears the rock.

lines.zh: 我的心跳比溪水还快。
lines.en: My heartbeat runs faster than the stream.

lines.zh: 我向前挪了半寸，没有声音。
lines.en: I creep forward half an inch, soundlessly.

lines.zh: 我撞你脚踝，像被苔藓碰了一下。
lines.en: I strike your ankle like a brush of moss.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够掀起一点沙。
lines.en: My strength can only lift a little sand.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的鞋带，立刻松开。
lines.en: I bite your shoelace and release it at once.

lines.zh: 三点生命，我打不出伤。
lines.en: Three hearts of life; I deal no damage.

lines.zh: 我用吻部顶你，顶得自己后退。
lines.en: I butt you and knock myself backward.

lines.zh: 水花溅起，那是我全部的攻势。
lines.en: The splash is the whole of my attack.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿转，找不到破绽。
lines.en: I circle your legs and find no opening.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就撞了第二次。
lines.en: You stand still, so I ram a second time.

lines.zh: 我很小，但这条溪是我的。
lines.en: I am small, but this stream is mine.

lines.zh: 这一口只在水面上留下圈纹。
lines.en: This bite leaves only rings on the water.

lines.zh: 我从苔池深处游了出来。
lines.en: I swim out from deep in the mossy pool.

lines.zh: 溪水拐弯的地方，我出现了。
lines.en: Where the stream bends, I appear.

lines.zh: 三到五条，一起藏在石缝。
lines.en: Three to five of us hide in the rocks together.

lines.zh: 冬天的溪最清，我就在这里。
lines.en: The winter stream is clearest; here I am.

lines.zh: 我先在阴影里待了很久。
lines.en: I stayed a long while in the shade first.

lines.zh: 水声盖住我破水而出的动静。
lines.en: The stream's noise covers my breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 我和同伴沿着同一道暗影进来。
lines.en: My schoolmates and I enter along one shadow.

lines.zh: 这条溪比湖更冷，也更安全。
lines.en: This stream is colder than the lake, and safer.

lines.zh: 卵石下多了一道细小的影子。
lines.en: Under the gravel there is one more small shadow.

lines.zh: 我比别的鳟鱼小，也藏得更好。
lines.en: I am smaller than other trout, and better hidden.

lines.zh: 火一沾水面的我，鳞片立刻卷起。
lines.en: Flame touches me at the surface and my scales curl.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，苔的湿气也救不了我。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, even the moss's damp cannot save me.

lines.zh: 水太浅太浑，我的鳃被泥堵住。
lines.en: The water is shallow and thick; mud clogs my gills.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻溪底，我被震得发懵。
lines.en: The blast flips the stream bed and stuns me.

lines.zh: 箭射进溪里，从我背鳍边穿过。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the stream past my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 魔法的光在苔池里亮起，我眼睛发花。
lines.en: Magic light blooms in the mossy pool and blinds me.

lines.zh: 我太谨慎，错过了太多虫子。
lines.en: I was too cautious and missed too many insects.

lines.zh: 雷打在溪面，我整个身体僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits the stream and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 水底裂开，我掉进没有水的黑。
lines.en: The stream bed splits and I fall into dry dark.
